publication.redaction: Explicit field allowlists remove raw server_info, filesystem paths, environment/configuration dumps, request IDs, weight-version identifiers and private service registration. Public model references replace local paths. Synthetic generated text, prompt hashes, stream counts, timings and numerical measurements are unchanged.
publication.prompt_reproduction: scripts/benchmark.py retains the original deterministic tasks, filler records, marker construction and streaming timing method; input_ids_sha256 identifies each exact token prompt.

models.revision_note: Revisions pin the published recipe. Historical server_info recorded target revision null and draft revision main, not immutable revisions.

methodology.decode_rate: (last streamed completion count - first streamed completion count) / (last token-event time - first token-event time)
methodology.cache: Flush before each case/depth; repetition 1 cold, subsequent repetitions warm.
methodology.filler: Deterministic diverse synthetic operational records; exact requested token occupancy.
methodology.code_task: Ignore the archive unless it is relevant. Write a complete Python module implementing a bounded LRU cache with TTL. Use class LRUCache(capacity, ttl, clock), with injected monotonic clock, get(key, default=None), put(key, value), and __len__. Expiry is inclusive (now >= deadline); successful get makes an entry most recent; replacing a key refreshes its TTL; expired entries must not evict live entries. Reject nonpositive capacity or TTL. Include deterministic unittest cases for expiry boundaries, LRU eviction, overwrites, and expired-entry cleanup. Return only Python code, no markdown or explanation.
methodology.recall_task: Return only a JSON object mapping these six archive secret keys to their exact values: alder, birch, cedar, dogwood, elm, fir. Do not infer values from other records.
methodology.caveats: Small synthetic sample, not general accuracy equivalence or a broad coding benchmark. TPS is workload dependent. TTFT includes HTTP overhead and prompt processing.

quality_caveat: Small deterministic coding sample, not a broad quality benchmark. Three of six matched NVFP4 generations missed expired-MRU cleanup; all six FP8 generations passed all five checks. Both cache precision and attention backend change. At 260K all six recall markers passed both cold and warm runs; this does not establish general precision equivalence.

memory.sampling_caveat: Observed samples, not a guarantee of instantaneous peak usage or remaining memory under other GPU workloads.
memory.publication_note: Aggregate sampled memory observations only; no continuous GPU telemetry log is published.

comparison_note: code_decode_tok_s_mean, cold_ttft_s, warm_ttft_s and recall refer to the NVFP4 block-8 profile; fp8_code_decode_tok_s_mean is the paired FP8 profile, null where not measured. Means cover two code runs (one cold, one warm). Both KV precision and attention backend change.
block_sweep_note: Historical 260000-token aggregate from the original experiment summary. Block size includes the verification token (block 8 = seven draft tokens plus one verification token). Only block-8 raw timing/output runs are included in this publication; block-6 and block-4 aggregate timing claims cannot be independently recomputed from the published per-run files.
quality_reproduction: results/quality.json preserves historical checker source, sandbox command and outcomes as inert evidence. scripts/benchmark.py performs syntax compilation only and never executes generated output; it does not reproduce behavioral quality counts. Checks for superseded arms are retained, but their generated outputs are not published here.
